note: A 4 x 6 x 8 box centred on the origin with a hole of diameter 2 along `axis`, through. The hole removes a cylinder of the box's extent `length` along the axis: V = V_box - pi r^2 length; it takes two discs of the faces and adds the cylinder's wall, A = A_box - 2 pi r^2 + 2 pi r length. It is centred, so the centroid stays the origin.
